key_insight: LAaDT-DSS helps non-experts assess rooftop PV investment, state incentive costs and feeder limits under Turkish tariff rules using one simulation core.
engineering_relevance: The system connects household economics, public incentive design and grid constraints through map-based and plain-language interfaces.
method: Access simulations by clicking a house on a 3D map or asking in plain language.
Use a language model to call simulation tools rather than perform calculations.
Label all 125 registry parameters as sourced or estimated.
evidence_signal: PV yield agreed within ±3.6% of two independent tools at equal losses; across 2,048 estimated-input draws, the PV-only decision changed once, while battery-inclusive decisions changed in 31–41% of draws.
watch_item: Battery-inclusive decisions were sensitive to estimated inputs, and usability remains unvalidated beyond four scripted chat scenarios with no user study.
paper_title: LAaDT-DSS: decision support for non-experts on rooftop PV, incentive and grid simulations under Turkish tariff rules
